Package org.bsc.langgraph4j.state

Class AppenderChannel<T>

java.lang.Object
org.bsc.langgraph4j.state.AppenderChannel<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of the values being accumulated
All Implemented Interfaces:
LG4JLoggable, Channel<List<T>>
public class AppenderChannel<T> extends Object implements Channel<List<T>>, LG4JLoggable
AppenderChannel is a Channel implementation that is used to accumulate a list of values.

      public final Object update(String key, Object oldValue, Object newValue)
      Updates the value for a given key in the channel.
      Specified by:
      update in interface Channel<T>
      Parameters:
      key - The key for which the value needs to be updated.
      oldValue - The old value that is being replaced.
      newValue - The new value to be set. If null, the old value will be returned.
      Returns:
      The updated old value or the new value if the update was successful.
      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - If the channel does not support updates, typically due to an immutable list being used.
